map.算法（简化）：静息即有症状→Ⅳ级；日常活动轻度受限→Ⅱ级；明显受限→Ⅲ级；无症状: Algorithm (simplified): symptoms at rest → class IV; mild limitation of daily activity → class II; marked limitation → class III; no symptoms → class I. Judged by breathlessness after activity, whether there are symptoms at rest and the degree of limitation.
map.例1（活动后气促、非静息、无明确受限）：判 Ⅱ级（轻度受限，日常活动稍喘）。例2: Example 1 (breathlessness after activity, not at rest, no clear limitation): class II (mild limitation, slightly breathless on daily activity). Example 2 (symptoms at rest): class IV (breathless even at rest, the most severe).
map.NYHA 和心衰分期一样吗？: Is NYHA the same as heart-failure staging?
map.不同：NYHA 是症状分级（Ⅰ–Ⅳ），ACC/AHA 分期是病程（A–D）；NY: No: NYHA is a symptom classification (I-IV), whereas the ACC/AHA stage is a disease course (A-D); NYHA reflects the current functional status and can change with treatment.
map.仅供理解；确切分级由医生结合运动试验与射血分数等综合判定，切勿自行诊断。: For understanding only; the exact class is determined by a doctor using exercise testing and ejection fraction together — do not self-diagnose.
